next.reason: A 1985 nonnumeric literal is quotation-mark delimited. §2023:8.3.3.2.3 SR3, 'Two contiguous quotation symbol characters matching the quotation symbol used in the opening delimiter', still makes a doubled quotation mark stand for one there. Apostrophe-delimited literals are new syntax that no 1985 program uses, so the recheck's 'apostrophe literal' difference concerns no 1985 source. §2023:8.3.3.2.3 SR4 ('shall be in the same coded character set representation as the opening quotation symbol') constrains the same pair, and single-repertoire 1985 source meets it.
